note: P4307 (Pro 27:21) — the crucible for silver, the furnace for gold, and a man by his praise.

dims.v: the assay of praise — how a man handles praise reveals him
the testing of a man by his praise — as fire assays metal, so praise assays the person, revealing by his response to it whether he is humble or vain, solid or hollow
(the fire that assays silver and gold)
the praise that proves a man's true mettle
mahalal (praise) — 'a MAN is tested by his praise'; praise is a crucible — how one bears it (with humility or vanity) reveals the true metal of the soul. Applause assays character (cf 27:2; 12:8).
